---
title: "Coastline Chunks"
format: html
---

```{r}
# 1. Load necessary libraries
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(units)
library(lwgeom)
library(ggplot2)

# 2. Load the coastline shapefile
ca_coastline <- st_read(here::here("data", "coastal_spatial_data", "coast.line.CA",
                                 "coast.line.CA.shp")) 
```

```{r}
st_line_sample(ca_coastline, n=10)
```


```{r}
ca_coastline_segmented <- st_segmentize(ca_coastline, set_units(100, km))
```


```{r}
ca_coastline_segmented %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf()
```


```{r}
tm_shape(ca_coastline_segmented) + 
    tm_lines() 
```
